utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, are you going to the repair drive Saturday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'll be there! I'm really excited to see everyone come together for this.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great! Don't forget it's at the community center parking lot. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Quinn, I was just talking to Rosa about the repair drive—I haven't lined up any volunteers yet, but I'd love to help brainstorm if you have any ideas.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect timing! I was thinking we could hit up the folks on Maple Street—they’re always game for a project. Want to split the list with me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I'm ready to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I already started sorting through the spare paint and lumber in my garage. Let me know what else you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to know, Cleo. I'm still figuring out what's needed, but I'll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I have a good amount of paint and lumber ready. Do you need me to bring any tools like hammers or saws?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, so I haven't missed it! I'll go grab that blender.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, the repair drive isn't until next weekend—are you bringing the blender to the event?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Next weekend? Oh dear, I keep mixing up my dates. Thanks for setting me straight, Hana!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's a great idea, Opal! We can definitely work around school drop-off and pick-up times.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, what repair drive? Did I miss another community event?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's a community center repair drive this weekend - we're getting together to fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, the repair drive's going great! I've got my toolbox handy if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if I can figure out where to start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, what's first on your list? I can help you sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you check the toolkit yet? We need to make sure we have everything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, I was just about to head out for errands. Have you checked it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hey Vik, have you heard anything about when that repair drive is supposed to start? I really need a definite time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: The repair drive is next Saturday, but I don't know the exact start time yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hmm, they really should give us a specific time. I can't plan my day around 'sometime Saturday'.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, I heard about the repair drive. Need any help getting things organized?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Sam, that's so sweet of you! We could definitely use an extra hand with setting up the tables and sorting the appliances.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Count me in! I'll come by early Saturday and we can get those tables set up and things sorted in no time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven't had a chance to look at the manual yet, but I think we should before we start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I wouldn't risk it without checking first. Let's find that manual.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think I saw it in the garage last week. Let me grab it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey sorry I'm late! What's the plan for the repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring your broken items to the community center this Saturday at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll bring my old toaster then. Anything else I should know?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly standard stuff: hammers, screwdrivers, paintbrushes, and some extension cords. But really, any help is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, standard tools. I'll see if I can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo! Every bit helps. I'll be there Saturday morning if you decide to come.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm still waiting on a specific time. Have you heard anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry Eli, I just got here too. Haven't heard a time yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, let's hope someone posts a schedule soon. I can't stand these vague timelines.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Bo, do you know what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it's 9 AM Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that works with my morning. Is there a sign-up sheet or anything for volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring your broken stuff to the community center Saturday at 10. We'll fix it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, Leo! I'll bring my toolbox and be ready to help out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. See you Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I'm helping out with the repair drive this Saturday. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Sam! I'd love to join. Have you had any luck rounding up other helpers?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Leo's on board too. He mentioned we're fixing the playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, did you say something about the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, it's just a day where folks help each other fix things. Not sure if I'll be able to join this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries, Uli. I understand if you're busy. Is there anything I can do to help make it easier for you to participate?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great idea, Tess! I'll help you put up those flyers later today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got the paint and lumber sorted, and I'll grab some brushes and rollers too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo! That'll be a huge help. I'll grab the snacks and meet you both at the center on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, it's supposed to fix our system, but I'm worried about whether it's actually compatible with ours.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What makes you think it might not be compatible?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, have you heard anything new about when the repair drive is coming?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm not sure it's even going to work when it gets here. Have we confirmed it's the right one for our system?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's a good point—Eli mentioned they haven't given a timeline yet, and I'm starting to wonder if it'll even fit.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules! So the plan is to have a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday—bring broken stuff and we fix it together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds awesome, Vik! I'll spread the word to my other friends—maybe we can get even more people involved.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Jules! I'm bringing my broken toaster. See you next Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Tess, I'm so forgetful — did we decide on a time for the repair drive? I have an old blender to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it's starting at 10 AM on Saturday, but let me double-check with Quinn. I'll let you know for sure!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, 10 AM Saturday sounds right, but don't remind me—I'll probably forget again! Thanks for checking, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're needing hammers, screwdrivers, paintbrushes—anything basic for repairs and painting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I see. So it's like a community tool-sharing thing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Exactly! Everyone brings what they can spare, and we all work together to fix up the center. Are you able to join us this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive starts at 9 AM Saturday in the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, 9 AM Saturday? I better get my things together then. I've been meaning to ask around but kept putting it off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm glad you're planning to come. Let me know if you need any help gathering supplies!

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
